jobDescription:
Data Engineer — Batch and Streaming

You will own the pipelines that feed our analytics and machine learning platforms.

Responsibilities:
- Build batch pipelines in Apache Spark (Scala and PySpark)
- Orchestrate workflows in Airflow with clear SLAs and backfill strategies
- Maintain streaming ingestion through Kafka into our lakehouse
- Model data in dbt and maintain the warehouse layer in Snowflake
- Own data quality checks and lineage documentation

Requirements:
- 4+ years in data engineering
- Production Spark experience at terabyte scale
- Strong SQL, including window functions and query tuning
- Comfort with the JVM ecosystem
